text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Mhm. It's nice to see the students going
about
their daily lives with such vigor.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
However, my presence seems to have
put some
on edge.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I understand, but I do wish they'd find
me more
approachable...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps I should take a page from Fuji
Kiseki.
Learning magic tricks might
soften my image.
